fit_reason: Private seller listing a whole 2019 Ram 1500 pickup, which we can detail inside and out.
findings: Dirt, grime and debris on the driver-side rubber floor mat and floor area
Dust and scuffing on the dashboard and center console plastics
Worn, shiny grime on the steering wheel rim
Dirt and scuffs on the driver door sill and lower door panel
Boxed parts and loose items left on the passenger floor
Faded, slightly hazy headlight lens visible in the front three-quarter photo
Black plastic front bumper and grille looking slightly dull
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the orange Ram 1500. The paint looks good, but the driver floor and door sill show a fair amount of dirt, and the steering wheel and dash could use a cleanup before buyers see it. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
